config.description: Origin of your WardenPoint installation, without a trailing slash and without /api/v1 — e.g. https://wardenpoint.com. The server reads the API description from it at startup, so the tools always match the version you actually run.

config.label: A company API key from Dashboard → Integrations → API keys
config.description: A company API key from Dashboard → Integrations → API keys. Abilities are chosen when you issue it; read-only is a good place to start. Not needed for --list-tools.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

config.label: Set to 1 to skip certificate verification
config.description: Set to 1 to skip certificate verification. Development stands only — never against production.
